title: Installments
emptyDescription: Bought something in installments? Add it here; it posts as an expense every month and you always see how many are left.
reliefTitle: Relief timeline — your monthly load drops by this much as plans end
closeDescription: The plan stops today; future installments won't post, past ones stay in your ledger. (Use this if you paid it off early at the bank.)
deleteDescription: The plan is deleted; already-posted installments stay in transactions.
modalCreateSubtitle: Enter once; it posts monthly and ends on the last installment.
modalEditSubtitle: Name, category and note can be changed.
lockedHint: Amount, count and start date are locked — delete and recreate the plan to change them.
toastClosed: Plan closed; future installments won't post.
